verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs show a role-based permission model: users have roles such as admin, business owner and employee, and agent actions respect the user's role. Ramp also documents entity-level restrictions, and admins can restrict Ramp MCP access by roles, departments or specific users. This is only glancing evidence of a general, configurable role and permission system for team members. missing for 10: documented custom or granular role definitions, location-level permission scoping, a department-level permission model outside the MCP feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can define granular user roles and permissions across team members, locations, and departments

citations.quote: Set restrictions based on roles, departments, or specific users
